task_description: Replicate for PRIMARY (STD4 / Darasa la IV) schools exactly what was done for SECONDARY: source the Mwanza council-level (MWANZA CC ...) and region-level (MKOA ... / ... Preserve the lakezone success example and all secondary reports unchanged. Real fonts, no fallbacks; honest fidelity reporting with the documented metric-compatible-Liberation residual.
